topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: Hey, I just heard about the transfer. I know we've been talking less since you got so swamped with projects, and now this... I wish I'd found a way to check in more often, you know? It's just, I've been so buried in my own stuff, and I'm really going to miss you around here. The office won't be the same, honestly. I hope you find a silver lining in this, and I'm here, okay? Anytime, for anything. We should grab a coffee soon and catch up properly. You've got to tell me all about your new setup—and hey, maybe there's something I can do to help ease the transition. Looking forward to it. Take care, and don't be a stranger.
